headline: Executive order called Preserve America directs federal efforts to protect and promote historic places.
what_it_does: This order focuses on preserving America's historic heritage. It is generally understood to direct federal agencies to take better care of historic buildings and sites they own, keep track of them, and report on their condition. It also encourages partnerships with states, tribes, local communities, and private groups, including through heritage tourism. No official summary was provided, so details here are limited.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that own or manage historic properties
who_it_affects.how: They are expected to identify, protect, and report on the historic sites and buildings in their care.
They may work with federal agencies on preserving historic places and promoting them to visitors.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 3, 2003; executive orders like this usually take effect when signed.
